items.text: With new information early this week, #49ers and De’Zhaun Stribling make a smart decision and opt to repair his deltoid rupture. Surgery will allow a complete recovery and Stribling should be back in late November or early December. ETR flags Deebo Samuel as primary beneficiary.
items.why: Deltoid rupture surgery; ~10 weeks, return late Nov/early Dec.
items.implication: SF WR snaps open; Deebo elevated role and targets.
items.opportunity: Deebo Samuel routes/targets/red-zone expansion as clear beneficiary.

items.text: Bengals QB Joe Burrow told reporters that he is dealing with “back tightness”, but he expects to play Sunday at Houston against the Texans. Did not practice Wednesday but got mental reps.
items.why: Back tightness; limited/DNP Wednesday but self-reports expects to play.
items.implication: Likely active Week 2; CIN pass catchers remain viable if he goes.

items.text: An early negative sign: Jim Harbaugh said WR Ladd McConkey (rib) won’t practice today.
items.why: Rib injury from Week 1; day-to-day but no Wednesday practice.
items.implication: Game-time or OUT risk Week 2 vs LV; have backup plan.
items.opportunity: Tre Harris and Quentin Johnston role expansion if out.

items.text: Deebo Samuel is a waiver wire target this week. With Stribling injury, 21% target share in Week 1 plus red-zone work; ETR lists as primary beneficiary alongside Demarcus Robinson.
items.why: Stribling long-term out opens SF WR snaps; Deebo already saw solid Week 1 usage.
items.implication: Top waiver add for immediate and ROS WR upside.

items.text: ETR ROS rankings and shows discussing Ashton Jeanty among key adjustments post-Week 1. Fantasy Life utilization: Jeanty 73% snaps, 70% rushes, 61% routes, 21% targets for high-end RB1 upgrade; 23 att/6 tgt, 156 yds scrimmage.
items.why: Dominant every-down usage in LV debut confirms lead back with receiving work.
items.implication: High-end RB1 ROS; lock in lineup and trade value up.
items.opportunity: Snap/rush/route/target shares elite; goal-line and two-minute likely.

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins was limited at practice Wednesday due to a hamstring injury.
items.why: Hamstring injury noted on Wednesday practice report.
items.implication: Monitor for Week 2 availability vs Bengals; potential target reduction if limited further.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for other HOU WRs if he sits or is limited.

items.text: #Patriots RB TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) was a full participant in today’s practice, an indication he could return on Sunday.
items.why: Ankle; full participant Wednesday signals return likelihood.
items.implication: Likely active Week 2; NE RB committee or lead role possible.
items.opportunity: Henderson snap/carry share if cleared; reverse prior handcuff beneficiaries.

items.text: Broncos RB RJ Harvey did not practice today due to a hamstring injury.
items.why: Hamstring issue after MNF appearance; estimated DNP as team did not practice.
items.implication: Questionable for Week 2 vs JAX; handcuff/backup opportunity if out.
items.opportunity: Increased carries for other DEN RBs if Harvey sits.

items.text: Seahawks ruled out QB Sam Darnold for Sunday’s game vs. the Cardinals due to his glute injury. The team currently has no plans to place Darnold on IR.
items.why: Glute injury; ruled out Week 2 but no IR plans.
items.implication: Drew Lock starts; SEA pass catchers face uncertainty but short-term only.
items.opportunity: Jadarian Price and SEA skill upside in run-heavy or Lock-friendly schemes.

items.text: The #Ravens are placing WR Ja’Kobi Lane on Injured Reserve after he had wrist surgery to quicken the recovery process. He’s out four games.
items.why: Wrist surgery; IR for 4 games to speed recovery.
items.implication: BAL WR depth hit; Bateman/Moore beneficiaries short-term.
items.opportunity: Rashod Bateman and other BAL WRs increased targets/routes.

items.text: As expected, Kenneth Walker went to KC to be a true workhorse. Last night: Handled 29 of the first 32 RB opportunities; Ran 19 routes on 33 Mahomes dropbacks; Tied for team-high with 6 targets for a 22% share; 23-173-1 rushing, 3-18-1 receiving. He fucks.
items.why: Dominant opportunity share in KC debut confirms workhorse role with high routes/targets.
items.implication: Elite RB1 ROS; every-down usage including receiving.

items.text: 49ers TE Jake Tonges will be out for the season after undergoing surgery for a torn MCL.
items.why: Torn MCL requiring surgery; placed on IR.
items.implication: SF TE depth thinned; more targets to remaining TEs/WRs.
items.opportunity: George Kittle volume secure; potential for other SF pass catchers.

items.text: Jameson Williams had the 8th-most expected fantasy points at WR in Week 1. He simply played a horrific game.
items.why: Elite expected FP (targets/location/depth) but poor conversion; process over results.
items.implication: Buy-low; strong underlying opportunity for rebound.
items.opportunity: High xFP via targets and field position indicates role is there.

items.text: Jaguars' intention for Hunter's role this season was very clear after Week 1 specialized package (4 offensive snaps, no routes past LOS). They didn't have to trade for/extend Meyers, could've traded BTJ, etc. Not drawing dead but long season.
items.why: Offseason actions + Week 1 usage (specialized package only) show limited offensive intent.
items.implication: Temper expectations for offensive fantasy production early.
